title: Rabbi Elazar, father of Rabbi Yitzchak bar Nachman
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1, reporting in the name of Rabbi Hoshaya. Hyman says that it should undoubtedly read “brother of R-Y B-G” (אחוי דר״י ב״ג).

notes.text: The heading calls Elazar the father of Yitzchak bar Nachman; Hyman’s proposed reading instead calls him a brother. The correction’s initials דר״י ב״ג have not been resolved into a full name.

The saved named Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1 paragraph explicitly has Elazar, father of Yitzchak bar Nachman, reporting Rabbi Hoshaya. Hyman’s “undoubtedly” proposes brother against that father reading. The contextual candidate Yitzchak bar Nachman does not prove the final ג/נ in supplied דר״י ב״ג, so those initials remain unresolved and no genealogy is merged.

The consulted scan of Hyman (vol. I, p. 159) appears to read ב״ג, as does the supplied text. The Guggenheimer edition of Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1 and the Daat presentation labeled Vilna both name Elazar as the father of Yitzchak bar Nachman, reporting Rabbi Hoshaya. Yitzchak bar Nachman gives a contextual possibility for the initials. Hyman’s proposed “brother” remains his emendation.
